wheel.label: Color wheel
wheel.ringKeys: Arrows: 1°. Shift + arrows: 10°. Page Up and Page Down: 30°, the next hue.
wheel.triangleKeys: Right and Left: more or less pure. Up and Down: lighter or darker. 1% per step, 10% with Shift.
wheel.pointerHelp: Drag on the ring to change the hue, and inside the triangle to add white or black.
wheel.touchHelp: With a finger, the point follows your movement without jumping under it, so it stays visible. Tap to jump to a spot.
wheel.keyboardHelp: With the keyboard, move to the ring or the triangle with Tab and use the arrows.
wheel.modelHelp: RYB (red, yellow and blue) is the traditional wheel of paint, the one for mixing pigments: its complements are red and green, yellow and violet, and blue and orange. Digital is the wheel of screens (RGB), with other complements, such as blue and yellow.
wheel.hexInvalid: Enter a hex color such as #3daf44.
